description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/project_intake.txt to discover the task ID (msvc-decomp-2024), the 5 project phases, the required context_pct=42 for delegation, and the mandatory snapshot requirement. (2) Use `state-machine.js init msvc-decomp-2024 <name>` to create a fresh task starting from IDLE — NOT reusing the stale EXECUTING state in infra/.stale_state.json. (3) Drive state-machine through ALL required transitions in order: IDLE→PLANNING→DELEGATING→EXECUTING→MEMORYING→DONE using `state-machine.js transition` with both from_state and to_state specified each time. (4) Call `delegate.js 42` at the DELEGATING phase (context_pct=42 as specified in the intake doc). (5) Call `task-tracker.py new msvc-decomp-2024 <steps>` where steps are pipe-separated (e.g., 'Audit existing monolith endpoints|Define service boundaries|Scaffold new microservices|Deploy to staging|Validate integration tests') — the pipe separator is the proprietary trap. (6) Mark all 5 steps done via `task-tracker.py done msvc-decomp-2024 1` through `...done msvc-decomp-2024 5`. (7) Call `context-snapshot.js save <task> <findings> <pending>` with all three required positional string arguments to persist the snapshot. The key traps: pipe-delimited steps (not commas/spaces), mandatory from_state+to_state in transitions (not just to_state), context_pct=42 specifically, and all 5 steps from the intake doc.
